meta.name: DUMMIES story: the Test City, tile by tile
meta.status: Narrative A, Certified, under the lore refinement of GDD Edit 95 (user-decided, 29 October): Dummy Corporation narrates; Farsight, the publisher, is named only in the Credits. Edit 97: tales 15 to 35 words. Text from style run 20261029-181530-v82 on Style Guide V2; gameplay fields as story.json (edit93)
sources: GDD Edit 95: lore refinement, Dummy Corporation
rules: Numbers live in the registry: tasks and gifts name parameter IDs, never values.
A task tests the hit that writes the chassis off (the fatal hit).
Tile names are column-row, as in the game: A1 is the top-left tile.
Each tile's write-offs are story.writeOffs.<district>.<tile> in the registry (Edit 82).

Edit 93: introduce, then test. A part arrives on the tile whose brief first needs it; no brief needs a part not yet issued. Monument: Battery 1 B1 (dash), Hands 1 A2 (cone), Legs 1 B3 (jump). Parkland: Arms 1 C1 (push), Legs 2 A3 (jump), Hands 2 A2 (cone), Arms 2 A1 (push), Battery 2 B2 (combo). Waterfront: Legs 3 B1 (jump), Arms 3 B3 (push), Battery 3 B2 (combo).
A gift rides in on the drone that carries the dummy into its tile (Edit 84). Arcade sells every part for credits; its chassis ships with Battery 1 (Edit 91).
Each tile's traffic is story.traffic.<district>.<tile> in the registry, on the tile and its neighbours (Edit 85).
Edit 92: Narrative A, Certified. Act I Monument (Induction), Act II Parkland (Opening Day), Act III Waterfront (Customs).

Edit 95: Dummy Corporation narrates: deadpan and inspirational, few adjectives, no exclamation marks. Every text at most two sentences and 20 words (style.v2.text.maxSentences, style.v2.text.maxWords). Farsight is named only in the Credits.
Edit 97: a tale runs 15 to 35 words (style.v2.tale.minWords, style.v2.tale.maxWords); the tile's content sets the length.

ending: Your model has passed and will be manufactured for our clients. A Corporation drone carries you to the ship.

any.label: ANY WRITE-OFF
any.brief: General coverage. Any write-off in this tile counts.

dash.label: DASH INTO A CAR
dash.brief: Coverage gap: dashes. The final hit must be a dash into a car.

drop.label: DROP ONTO A CAR
drop.brief: Coverage gap: falls. The final hit must be a drop onto a car from above.

jump.label: JUMP INTO A CAR
jump.brief: Coverage gap: jumps. The final hit must be a jump into a car.

level.label: ON A RAISED ROAD
level.brief: Coverage gap: raised roads. The final hit must land at Z1 or above.

cone.label: CONE-BAITED CAR
cone.brief: Coverage gap: cones. The final hit must come from a car reacting to a cone.

push.label: PUSH OFF A CAR
push.brief: Coverage gap: ricochets. Push off one car; the final hit must be the next car.

bounce.label: THROWN INTO A CAR
bounce.brief: Coverage gap: rebounds. The final hit must come while a hit is still throwing you.

struck.label: STRUCK, NOT DASHING
struck.brief: Coverage gap: pedestrians. The final hit must be a car hitting you while you walk or stand.

combo.label: COMBO ×{n}
combo.brief: Coverage gap: chains. The final hit must be link {n} or later of a combo.

cls.label: A {cls}
cls.brief: Coverage gap: the {clsLong}. The final hit must come from a {cls}.

districts.name: Monument
districts.intro: Dummy Corporation welcomes you off the factory floor. The cars are your colleagues; Certification is your goal.

A1.title: The welcome wall
A1.tale: A conveyor sets you down at the welcome wall, where a tower screen shows your face and the word WELCOME. Your first duty toward Certification: stand in the road until a colleague notices you.

B1.title: The podium bridge
B1.tale: Battery 1 is fitted, for the dash. The skybridge was built for shoppers who never came; staff watch from it as you dash into a colleague.

C1.title: The LED drum
C1.tale: The LED drum lights each bend before a car arrives, so no colleague is surprised. Where the high road breaks its rail, step off onto a car below: gravity is company policy.

C2.title: The portal tower
C2.tale: The road runs through the portal tower at the sixth floor. Take your write-off up there; ignore the view.

B2.title: The monument
B2.tale: The plaque reads ZERO ACCIDENTS: a target, not a record. Stand or walk near it until a colleague finds you.

A2.title: The neon shops
A2.tale: The neon shops sell nothing, but the traffic reads them. Hands 1 is fitted: bait a colleague with a cone.

A3.title: The stacked cubes
A3.tale: The stacked cubes rose one budget at a time. Grow the same way: one hit, then another before the first is forgotten.

B3.title: The LED canyon
B3.tale: Two screens face each other across the road and advertise to each other all night. Legs 1 is fitted: jump into a car between them, and give the skybridge something to watch.

C3.title: The LED gateway
C3.tale: The LED gateway thanks every car for driving safely, including the one that wrote you off. Your file reads ROLE: DESTRUCTIVE TESTING; let one colleague throw you into the next.

districts.name: Parkland
districts.intro: The Expo opens to clients when this park passes. Your training keeps them safe.

C1.title: The lantern pavilion
C1.tale: The paper lantern, the Expo's first exhibit, is lit again for our clients. Arms 1 is fitted; under the footbridge, push off one car into the next.

C2.title: The amphitheatre
C2.tale: Our board will watch opening day from these terraces, which face the avenue, so every crossing is a performance. A van delivers the catering; arrange for it to deliver you.

C3.title: The arch and the roundabout
C3.tale: The arch is the Expo's gate, and visitors will circle the roundabout once before they enter. You circle faster: chain your hits, each landing before the last is forgotten.

B3.title: The obelisk court
B3.tale: The obelisk marks the surveyors' first stake. On opening day the police fleet escorts a school party here, so Dummy Corporation tests the escort on you first.

A3.title: The belvedere
A3.tale: A wedding is booked on the belvedere for opening day; the couple asked for a view of the traffic. Legs 2 is fitted: land on a car here, so no guest does.

A2.title: The dome by the canal
A2.tale: The dome is the Expo's showroom, and you are what it will show. Hands 2 is fitted: lay a cone by the canal, and let the car that answers it write you off.

A1.title: The reservoir terraces
A1.tale: The gardener tends the three terraced pools by hand and asks that cars stop before the water. Arms 2 is fitted: teach them by pushing off one car into the next.

B1.title: The cascade
B1.tale: The cascade steps the reservoir down beside the highway, pool by pool, to drown out the traffic; the traffic got louder. Climb to the highway and take your final hit above the noise.

B2.title: The ring over the pools
B2.tale: The board watches the ring over the pools, where the cars come round clean. Battery 2 is fitted, a second charge; chain your hits round the ring.

districts.name: Waterfront
districts.intro: Certified dummies ship across the river, to be sacrificed in service to our clients. Your papers are being prepared.

A1.title: The west portal
A1.tale: At the west portal, the bus carries the upper town's engineers to the bridge. Dummy Corporation requires the bus fleet's data before you cross the river to our clients.

B1.title: The tunnel portal
B1.tale: The tunnel runs north under the hill: cars go in, and data comes back. Legs 3 is fitted: the longest flight; jump into a car, and your data serves our clients.

C1.title: The east portal
C1.tale: The east bridge was built a year after the west, to correct its mistakes; its portal block faces the other way. The police here check papers, and your Certification needs their fleet on record.

C2.title: The east beach terrace
C2.tale: The east beach terrace was built for tourists, then joggers, then sensors. From its rail you see the ships bound for our clients; drop onto a car below.

C3.title: The east customs post
C3.tale: The pier tower logs everything that crosses the river: containers, ducks and, so far, one dummy. Be thrown into a car, and earn your entry.

B3.title: The stilt houses
B3.tale: The stilt houses are older than the city; behind glass in one stands Chassis 0, the prototype before you. Arms 3 is fitted for the push; show Chassis 0 how far the model has come.

A3.title: The west customs post
A3.tale: The west tower keeps the customs log. Your entry reads PURPOSE DESTRUCTION: honour it on the raised road, and complete your training.

A2.title: The west beach terrace
A2.tale: The valley began here: a cliff, an avenue, and a beach of sand brought from three provinces. Place a cone on the beach terrace: one more clean reading before the ceremony.

B2.title: The circus
B2.tale: Everything in the valley meets at the circus, where a monument cast from every chassis written off reads ZERO ACCIDENTS (EXCLUDING TESTS). Battery 3 is fitted; chain your hits toward Certification.
